title: Standardising dates, currencies, units and codes

videos.script: Three of April, or fourth of March? The string 03/04/2025 cannot tell you. Only the system that wrote it can. {{ambiguous}} That is the shape of every problem in this lesson. A value whose meaning depends on a convention the file does not record. {{convention}} A date, day first or month first. A time, in São Paulo or in UTC. An amount, with a comma for the decimals and a point for the thousands. A weight, in kilos, grams, tonnes or pounds. A code that lost its leading zero. {{list}} The rule for all of them is the same. Find out the convention of each source. Convert with that convention written down, never guessed. And check the result against something independent. {{rule}} At the end, every order total is checked against its own lines. Twenty-eight thousand five hundred agree to the centavo. Seven do not, and lesson 9 finds out why. {{check}} One more thing. Money is never a float. You will see why in one line. {{end}}
